annotations.title: Answer a Los Angeles hotel question from published pages

description: Route a plain-language question about Los Angeles area hotels to the Journeyed page that answers it, with the same matcher journeyed.org/ask uses. For a question about one named hotel ("What time is check-in at Santa Monica Proper Hotel?") it returns the hotel's sourced answer with the source URL and checked date. For a question about a place ("Which hotels near LAX have a free shuttle?") it returns the page's direct answer, its top hotels and the page URL. It only returns what a published page states. When nothing matches, matched is false, no answer is returned and the closest pages are listed. It cannot answer about room prices, availability or guest reviews.

question.description: The question in plain words, naming the hotel or the place. Example: "Does The Anthem have parking?"

name: answer_question

alsoAnswered.description: Other close published answers about the same hotel.

closest.description: When matched is false: the nearest published pages. They may not answer the question.

matched.description: True only when a published page answers the question.

notices.description: Limits that apply to this question (for example: no room prices).

question.description: The published question that matched (compare it with what was asked).

items.description: One hotel of a ranked list, with its journeyed.org page URL.
One sourced fact. sourceUrl (a web page) or dataset (an open dataset id) says where it came from; checkedOn is the date it was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).
